chunks: Ali b. Ahmad b. Abdullah b. Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah al-Barqi (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from his grandfather Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah, from al-Hasan b. Ali b. Faddal, from Abdullah b. Bukayr, from Zurara b. A'yan. He said: I heard Abu Ja'far Muhammad b. Ali al-Baqir (peace be upon him) say:

A man entered a mosque in which was the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and hastened his prostration in a way that was unbefitting and less than what constitutes a prostration. So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: He pecked like the pecking of a crow. If he dies upon this, he dies upon a religion other than the religion of Muhammad.

key_terms.غير دين محمد: other than the religion of Muhammad — meaning outside the bounds of proper Islamic practice
key_terms.كنقر الغراب: like the pecking of a crow — a prophetic metaphor for hasty prayer
key_terms.نقر: pecking (used metaphorically for hasty, superficial prostration)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about performing prostration hastily like a crow?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir narrates that the Prophet observed a man performing prostration carelessly in the mosque, pecking the ground like a crow. The Prophet warned that such prayer is so deficient that dying in that state means dying outside the fold of Islam, emphasizing the importance of performing prostration properly and completely.

en.bilal-muhammad: `Ali b. Ahmad b. `Abdullah b. Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah al-Barqi (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from his grandfather Ahmad b. Abi `Abdillah from al-Hasan b. `Ali b. Faddal from `Abdullah b. Bukayr from Zurara b. A`yan. He said: I heard Aba Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali al-Baqir (as) say:

A man entered a mosque wherein which was the Messenger of Allah (s) and lightened (hastened) his prostration in a way that was unbefitting for a prostration. So, the Messenger of Allah (s) said: He pecked like the pecking of a crow. If he dies upon this, then he dies upon a religion other than the religion of Muhammad.
